verdict.rationale: Aircall's own documented rule-like automation is narrow. Users can set IVR keypad menus with business-hours scheduling to route incoming calls automatically, and AI Assistants update CRM records and create follow-up tasks automatically after conversations. Webhooks and the build-your-own smart-routing and overflow tutorials are developer building blocks rather than a user-facing rule engine, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable event→action rule builder, documented trigger/condition/action options beyond call routing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
